title: Quantize orcarouter/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-Uncensored-FP8 to Unsloth UD-IQ4_XS on 3x RTX 3090

hardware.note: Use the three 3090s only. Leave the 3060s out.

do_not: wire PLE to GPU at serve

steps.name: clone_playbook
steps.cmd: git clone https://github.com/groxaxo/qwen38-flash-next-sharp-chat-template && cd qwen38-flash-next-sharp-chat-template && chmod +x quantize_orcarouter_fp8.sh extract_gguf_tensor_map.py

steps.name: calib_text
steps.cmd: mkdir -p calib && curl -L --fail -o calib/wiki.train.raw https://huggingface.co/datasets/wikitext/resolve/main/wikitext-2-raw-v1/wiki.train.raw && head -c 8000000 calib/wiki.train.raw > calib/calib.txt

steps.name: quantize_unsloth_map
steps.cmd: SKIP_CONVERT=1 SRC=./out/Qwen38FN-Unc-FP8-unsloth-UD-IQ4_XS.master.q8_0.gguf RECIPE=unsloth QUANT=UD-IQ4_XS MAP=./maps/UD-IQ4_XS.tensor-types IMATRIX=./out/Qwen38FN-Unc-FP8-unsloth-UD-IQ4_XS.imatrix.gguf RECOMPUTE_IMATRIX=0 LLAMA_CPP=./llama.cpp OUT=./out/Qwen38FN-Unc-FP8-unsloth-UD-IQ4_XS ./quantize_orcarouter_fp8.sh

steps.name: verify_load_3x3090
steps.cmd: CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0,1,2 ./llama.cpp/build/bin/llama-cli -m ./out/Qwen38FN-Unc-FP8-unsloth-UD-IQ4_XS-00001-of-*.gguf --jinja --chat-template-file ./chat_template.jinja --reasoning-format deepseek -ngl 99 -sm layer -ts 1,1,1 --override-tensor per_layer_token_embd=CPU -fit off -c 4096 -n 64 -p 'Reply with the single word: pong' --temp 0

imatrix_oom_fallback: use AtomicChat imatrix.gguf and set RECOMPUTE_IMATRIX=0
agent_rules: Skip a step if its output already exists and size is sane.
Reuse the Q8 master from the UD-Q4_K_XL run if it already exists; only the map and OUT prefix change.
On imatrix OOM walk imatrix_oom_fallback in order.
Do not delete the Q8 master until verify exits 0.
Serve with PLE on CPU and -fit off.
serve_after: CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0,1,2 ./llama.cpp/build/bin/llama-server -m ./out/Qwen38FN-Unc-FP8-unsloth-UD-IQ4_XS-00001-of-*.gguf --mmproj mmproj-Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-Uncensored-F16.gguf --jinja --chat-template-file ./chat_template.jinja --reasoning-format deepseek -ngl 99 -sm layer -ts 1,1,1 --override-tensor per_layer_token_embd=CPU -fit off -c 32768 --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8080 --flash-attn on -t 12 -tb 20
